messages:
Anya P: Quick sync  PR #5001 updates SDK snippets for streaming + pagination. We migrated to async iterators and renamed pagination tokens. Need three tiny examples (py/ts/go) and a one-line migration note.
Sam W: I'll do Go. Swap Chunks() -> StreamIter() pattern.
Mike L: Python is mine. Will add a compact retry note (capped exponential backoff) and 'do not retry on 4xx'.
Nina K: TS examples + imports; will convert event callbacks to for-await-of.
docs-bot: CI: linkcheck flagged /docs/streams_old.md -> 404.
Anya P: Replace with /docs/streams and add mapping: page -> page_token, per_page -> page_size; responses include next_page_token. Keep migration blurb one short paragraph.
Sam W: Go snippet:
```go
it := client.StreamIter(ctx, req)
for it.Next() { fmt.Println(it.Value().Text) }
```
Mike L: Python snippet:
```py
from time import sleep

def tiny_retry(fn, tries=3):
  for i in range(tries):
    try: return fn()
    except TransientError:
      sleep(min(2**i, 5))
  raise

with client.stream_iter(prompt) as it:
  for chunk in it:
    print(chunk.text)
# note: do not retry on 4xx
```
Nina K: TS snippet:
```ts
for await (const chunk of client.streamIter(req)) {
  console.log(chunk.text)
}
```
Anya P: Thanks all; pushed fixes to PR #5001. Deploy preview linkcheck should pass after swapping the broken link.
